note: Madison County TX: the county does not publish zoning districts as a service. The City of Madisonville (county seat) zones itself and links a May 2026 zoning map from its planning page, but that map is published as a plain-text link to a document, not a queryable ArcGIS service; the official district map is kept by the city secretary (Code Sec. 46-58). Midway and North Zulch publish no zoning found. Searches of ArcGIS Online/Hub for Madison County TX zoning returned no zoning district layer; the Madison CAD viewer has no REST services. The only zoning-related items found are PDF/image maps, so viewer-only.
